note: Synthetic complaints written for the demo. Not real narratives. The expected behaviour is what the design should do, not a measured result; check it at rehearsal.

examples.use: auto-route path (the same text is built into the reviewer UI)
examples.text: There are three charges on my credit card statement from a store I have never visited. I called the card company the same day I saw them and reported them as fraud. They said they would investigate, but last week they told me the charges are valid and I have to pay them along with interest.
examples.expected: 200; product and team shown; route depends on the model's confidence

examples.text: I found an account on my credit report that does not belong to me. I have never opened an account with this lender. examples.expected: 200; credit-reporting product; route depends on confidence
